blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – President Ferdinand R.Marcos Jr. on Tuesday called for a more proactive response to disasters and calamities from members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) and enhance early warning systems as the region faces extreme natural events due to climate change. Marcos said Asean must improve its ability to anticipate hazards, understand their potential impacts and mobilize resources ahead of disasters instead of relying mainly on response after disasters / calamities occur. “This means accelerating people-centered, end-to-end, multi-hazard early warning systems,” Marcos said in a message delivered by Executive Secretary Ralph Recto at the Asean Ministerial Conference […]...
